description: surface.list under a kind filter: the four kinds are a CLOSED set (read · write · control · diagnostic) and the filtering is answered daemon-side, because a client that filtered the surface in a browser would be a client entitled to disagree with the daemon about what a door is. `diagnostic` is what S19's Debug marks, and it is exactly the set the public door keeps off HTTP — the two facts are one fact here, computed from the same entry and not remembered in two places. counts.byKind carries every bucket including the empty ones, so a zero is an answer the daemon gave and not a key the client failed to find.

methods.summary: Files an agent-to-agent ask as a WAITING task and returns; suspension is rows, not a blocked call.
The callee settles its task and reports its cost; a settled task answers by naming its state.
The callee fails its task with a required reason, recorded verbatim in the task envelope.
Dumps the daemon goroutine stacks, so a suspended agent task can be proven absent from outside the process.
Lists the live subscription registry — the demonstration that a dropped connection empties it.
